observations: Root directly viewed all 12 original PNGs after all three matching native comparisons passed.

Adult head: the lower-screen brow has a smoother continuous edge through its middle with fewer dark fragments. The upper-screen brow retains some stipple at this small pixel size. Improvement is modest at full stage scale.
Adult support: the exposed brow below the upper-screen fingertips reads more evenly. Hand placement and silhouette, palm contact, facial expression and head proportions appear consistent.
Infant high contrast: the small brow silhouette changes do not visibly disrupt eye separation, expression or stage framing.
The change is accepted as a focused brow surface improvement. The original 64 by 32 sampling resolution and all rendered resource counts remain unchanged.
limitations: Three matched raw-module views only. Full application loader/build/deployment not tested. Some small-scale facial stippling remains.
